title: 实验 3-5 · 呼吸灯：电容让 LED 慢慢亮、慢慢暗
summary: 0.5 Hz 方波经二极管给 1000 µF 电容充电，电容再通过 470 Ω 给 LED 供电：充电快、放电慢，LED 像呼吸一样一明一暗。
concepts: 充电与放电时间常数不同 different charge / discharge τ
二极管单向导电 diode blocks back-flow
description: **目标**：用一个二极管让电容的充电和放电走不同的路径，得到两个不同的时间常数，让 LED 像“呼吸”一样慢慢变亮、变暗。
**电路**：信号发生器红夹子 → 二极管 D1（正极朝信号发生器）→ R1（220 Ω）→ 结点 VC。VC 上接 C1（1000 µF，到 GND），同时接 R2（470 Ω）→ 红色 LED → GND。黑夹子接 GND。1000 µF 一般是电解电容，有极性：长脚（+）接 VC，短脚接 GND。
**信号发生器**：方波，幅度 4.5 V、偏置 4.5 V（0 ↔ 9 V），频率 0.5 Hz（周期 2 s，慢到眼睛能看清）。
**示波器**：CH1 接 VC，CH2 接 LED 正极。R2 上的电压 VC − V(LED+) 除以 470 Ω 就是 LED 电流。时基调到 500 ms/格左右。
**先预测**：高电平时电容经哪条路径充电？充电时间常数要用 VC 结点看进去的戴维宁电阻（信号发生器 50 Ω、LED 约 12 Ω 也要算上）。低电平时 D1 处于什么状态，电容只能经哪条路径放电？分别估算 τ充 和 τ放，想一想 LED 会不会完全熄灭。
**测量**：0.5 Hz 下看 VC 的最高、最低值和 LED 电流的起伏；然后把 D1 换成导线试试，再把频率调到 20 Hz 看看。电路检查通过后，把读数填进下面的「测量」（以你自己的面包板为准）；答完后会显示计算对比。
注：示波器的“亮 / 灭”判断按平均电流（人眼对快速闪烁取平均）。

en.title: Experiment 3-5 · Breathing LED: a capacitor makes the LED fade in and out
en.summary: A 0.5 Hz square wave charges a 1000 µF capacitor through a diode; the capacitor feeds an LED through 470 Ω. Fast charge, slow discharge: the LED "breathes".
description: **Goal**: use a diode to send the capacitor's charge and discharge along different paths, giving two different time constants, so the LED slowly brightens and dims as if "breathing".

**Circuit**: generator red clip → diode D1 (anode toward the generator) → R1 (220 Ω) → node VC. From VC, C1 (1000 µF) goes to GND, and R2 (470 Ω) → red LED → GND. Black clip to GND. A 1000 µF capacitor is usually electrolytic and polarised: long lead (+) to VC, short lead to GND.
**Generator**: square wave, amplitude 4.5 V, offset 4.5 V (0 ↔ 9 V), 0.5 Hz (2 s period, slow enough to follow by eye).
**Scope**: CH1 on VC, CH2 on the LED anode. The voltage across R2, VC − V(LED+), divided by 470 Ω is the LED current. Set the time base to about 500 ms/div.

**Predict first**: while the generator is high, along which path does the capacitor charge? The charging time constant uses the Thévenin resistance seen from VC (count the generator's 50 Ω and the LED's ~12 Ω). While it is low, what state is D1 in, and which path is left for the discharge? Estimate τ_charge and τ_discharge and decide whether the LED ever goes fully dark.

**Measure**: at 0.5 Hz watch VC's highest and lowest values and how the LED current rises and falls; then try D1 replaced by a wire, and then the frequency turned up to 20 Hz. Once the circuit check passes, type your readings into the Measurements below (whatever your own board shows); the worked comparison appears after you answer.
Note: the LED's on/off is judged by its average current (the eye averages fast blinking).
compare: - **High (9 V) for 1 s**: current flows through D1 and R1, charging the capacitor and lighting the LED. τ_charge ≈ C × [(R1 + 50 Ω) ∥ (R2 + 12 Ω)] ≈ 1000 µF × 173 Ω ≈ 0.17 s, so the LED brightens quickly.

- **Low (0 V) for 1 s**: D1 is reverse-biased, so the capacitor cannot flow back into the generator; it can only discharge slowly through R2 and the LED: LED current ≈ (VC − 1.8 V)/(470 + 12 Ω), decaying with τ_discharge ≈ 1000 µF × 482 Ω ≈ 0.48 s — the LED dims slowly.

- In steady state VC swings between about 2.3 V and 6.0 V; the LED current rises and falls between about 1.1 mA and 8.7 mA (about 0.5 V to 4.1 V across R2). It never goes fully dark, so it looks like breathing rather than blinking.

- **D1 replaced by a wire**: while the generator is low the capacitor quickly discharges back into the generator through R1 (τ only about 0.17 s); VC drops to about 0.1 V and the LED is completely off half the time — an ordinary slow blink.

- **20 Hz**: a 25 ms half period is far shorter than both time constants, so the capacitor has no time to charge or discharge much: VC is almost flat (≈ 4.9 V with ≈ 0.16 Vpp ripple) and the LED glows steadily (≈ 6.4 mA). That's capacitor smoothing — exactly the principle of the rectifier filters you'll meet later.

measurements.ask: 0.5 Hz: the highest value of CH1 (VC)
measurements.explain: Charging, τ ≈ 1000 µF × 173 Ω ≈ 0.17 s, so 1 s nearly reaches the final value set by the two branches: about 6.0 V.

measurements.ask: 0.5 Hz: the lowest value of CH1 (VC)
measurements.explain: While low, D1 is off and the capacitor can only discharge through R2 + LED, τ ≈ 1000 µF × 482 Ω ≈ 0.48 s, and the LED hardly conducts below about 1.8 V: VC only falls to about 2.3 V.

measurements.ask: 0.5 Hz: the minimum voltage across R2 (CH1 − CH2)
From your reading, the LED current at its dimmest, I = U_R2 / 470 Ω
measurements.explain: ≈ 0.5 V / 470 Ω ≈ 1.1 mA: the current never reaches 0, so it looks like breathing rather than blinking. Replace D1 with a wire and the capacitor dumps back into the generator through R1, and the LED is fully off half the time.
A 25 ms half period is far shorter than both time constants, so the capacitor barely moves: only about 0.16 Vpp ripple, the LED steady at ≈ 6.4 mA. That is capacitor filtering.

hints: Diode anode (no stripe) toward the generator, cathode (striped end) toward R1.
The capacitor and the R2 + LED branch both hang from the same node VC.
Charging goes through the diode; discharging can only go through R2 and the LED.
tests: 0.5 Hz: the LED breathes — the current rises and falls but never reaches zero
0.5 Hz: VC swings between two levels
20 Hz: the capacitor smooths it out — little ripple on VC, the LED stays steadily on

tests.name: 0.5 Hz：LED 呼吸——电流起伏，但从不完全熄灭
0.5 Hz：VC 在两个电平之间来回
20 Hz：电容滤平——VC 纹波很小，LED 稳定地亮

compare: - **高电平（9 V）1 s**：电流经 D1、R1 给电容充电，同时点亮 LED。τ充 ≈ C × [(R1 + 50 Ω) ∥ (R2 + 12 Ω)] ≈ 1000 µF × 173 Ω ≈ 0.17 s，所以 LED 很快亮起来。
- **低电平（0 V）1 s**：D1 反偏截止，电容不能倒灌回信号发生器，只能经 R2 和 LED 慢慢放电：LED 电流 ≈ (VC − 1.8 V)/(470 + 12 Ω)，按 τ放 ≈ 1000 µF × 482 Ω ≈ 0.48 s 指数减小——LED 慢慢变暗。
- 稳态下 VC 在约 2.3 V 和 6.0 V 之间来回；LED 电流在约 1.1 mA 和 8.7 mA 之间起伏（R2 上电压约 0.5 V ~ 4.1 V），从不完全熄灭，所以看起来是“呼吸”而不是“闪烁”。
- **D1 换成导线**：低电平时电容会经 R1 快速放电回信号发生器（τ 只有约 0.17 s），VC 掉到 0.1 V 左右，LED 有一半时间完全熄灭——变成普通的慢闪。
- **20 Hz**：半周期 25 ms 远小于两个时间常数，电容来不及充放，VC 几乎是一条直线（≈ 4.9 V，纹波约 0.16 Vpp），LED 稳定地亮着（≈ 6.4 mA）。这就是“电容滤波”：后面学到的整流滤波电路正是这个原理。

measurements.explain: 充电 τ充 ≈ 1000 µF × 173 Ω ≈ 0.17 s，1 s 里几乎充到终值：两条支路分压，约 6.0 V。
低电平时 D1 截止，电容只能经 R2 + LED 放电，τ放 ≈ 1000 µF × 482 Ω ≈ 0.48 s，而且 LED 低于约 1.8 V 就几乎不导通：VC 只降到约 2.3 V。

measurements.ask: 0.5 Hz：R2 两端电压（CH1 − CH2）的最小值
用你的读数算 LED 最暗时的电流 I = U_R2 / 470 Ω
measurements.explain: ≈ 0.5 V / 470 Ω ≈ 1.1 mA：电流从不降到 0，所以看起来是“呼吸”而不是“闪烁”。把 D1 换成导线，电容会经 R1 倒灌回信号发生器，LED 就有一半时间完全熄灭。

measurements.ask: 调到 20 Hz：VC 的纹波 Vpp
measurements.explain: 半周期 25 ms 远小于两个时间常数，电容来不及充放：纹波只有约 0.16 Vpp，LED 稳定在 ≈ 6.4 mA。这就是电容滤波。

hints: 二极管正极（没有色环的一端）朝信号发生器，负极（有色环）朝 R1。
电容和“R2 + LED”这条支路都挂在同一个结点 VC 上。
充电走二极管；放电只能走 R2 和 LED。
